verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a hosted AI code-review service, but the evidence pack never documents region or residency selection for Bugbot. The nearest items are adjacent controls: Privacy Mode (no training on your data), compliance certifications, and a hosted egress proxy with fixed IPs. None of these lets a user pick where data is stored, so none earns credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
